name: shoporbit
description: Frontend build tooling for Shop Orbit — compiled Tailwind CSS output plus vendored HTMX/Alpine.js. No JS bundler/framework: see docs/infrastructure.md.

scripts.vendor: cp node_modules/htmx.org/dist/htmx.min.js static/js/vendor/htmx.min.js && cp node_modules/alpinejs/dist/cdn.min.js static/js/vendor/alpine.min.js && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.min.js static/js/vendor/chart.min.js
